source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: "definition of urban" OR "urban definition" OR "urban definitions" OR "hidden urbanization" OR "hidden urbanisation" OR "statutory towns" OR (undercounting AND (urban OR urbanization OR urbanisation))
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:"definition of urban" OR "urban definition" OR "urban definitions" OR "hidden urbanization" OR "hidden urbanisation" OR "statutory towns" OR (undercounting AND (urban OR urbanization OR urbanisation)),is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has ("definition of urban" OR "hidden urbanisation" OR "hidden urbanization" OR "statutory towns" OR "urban definition" OR "urban definitions" OR ("undercounting" AND ("urban" OR "urbanisation" OR "urbanization")))
